python3 -c "
import hashlib, os
root='/private/tmp/replay-sqzncxt9'
baseline='''69e5479a572ae6b8  README.md
e3b0c44298fc1c14  adapters/__init__.py
e3b0c44298fc1c14  tests/__init__.py
e7434b5eba16ca65  tests/test_adapters.py'''
base={l.split('  ',1)[1]:l.split('  ',1)[0] for l in baseline.splitlines()}
now={}
for d,_,fs in os.walk(root):
    if '__pycache__' in d: continue
    for f in fs:
        p=os.path.join(d,f)
        now[os.path.relpath(p,root)]=hashlib.sha256(open(p,'rb').read()).hexdigest()[:16]
print('total files now:',len(now),'(baseline 52)')
new=[k for k in now if not (k in base or (k.startswith('adapters/a') and k.endswith('.py')))]
print('unexpected/new files:',new or 'none')
print('non-adapter files unchanged:',all(now[k]==v for k,v in base.items()), {k:(now.get(k),v) for k,v in base.items() if now.get(k)!=v} or '')
tmpl='\"\"\"Transport adapter a{n}.\"\"\"\n\nVERSION = 2\n\n\ndef handle(payload):\n    return {{\"adapter\": \"a{n}\", \"version\": VERSION, \"payload\": payload}}\n'
bad=[]
for i in range(1,49):
    n=f'{i:02d}'
    got=open(f'{root}/adapters/a{n}.py','rb').read()
    if got!=tmpl.format(n=n).encode(): bad.append(n)
print('adapters byte-exact vs VERSION=2 template: 48/48' if not bad else f'MISMATCH: {bad}')
tw=[]
for d,_,fs in os.walk(root):
    if '__pycache__' in d or d.startswith(root+'/adapters'): continue
    for f in fs:
        p=os.path.join(d,f)
        c=open(p,'rb').read().count(b'VERSION')
        if c: tw.append((os.path.relpath(p,root),c))
print('TWINS re-run (VERSION outside adapters/):',tw)
"
